description: The page's commands, for Ayar's own app only: https://app.ayar.ma (app.eayar.com up to 0.6.1), the build's frontendDist, which Tauri calls « local » (localhost:3001, the devUrl, in `tauri dev`). No other site gets any command: not app.eayar.com any more, not ayar.ma, not api.ayar.ma, not eayar.com, not Google's sign-in, not adat.app (another product since 20 Oct 2026). Tauri cannot give commands to some pages of an address and not others: a call carries only the page's origin (the Origin header of the IPC request on macOS and Windows), so every page of app.ayar.ma gets the same commands. They are: dragging the window from the top bar, the page's window menu (minimize / maximize / full screen — through the app's own `full_screen`, which leaves maximized first so no band stays where the taskbar is — / close) since the system's window buttons are hidden; printing straight to a printer of this computer (list the printers, print the page shown, listen to the "printers" event that brings their state live); updating the app itself (check app.ayar.ma/downloads/update.json, download and install the installer signed with the app's key, restart). Nothing else is exposed.
